note:
'These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.' (1Chr 6:31), and 'Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari' (23:6).

**Both verses look back from after his death**, which is why the arrangement is described rather than narrated: 1Chr 23:27 dates the numbering to 'the final instructions of David'.

'When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.' (1Chr 23:1) -- the Chronicler's one sentence for what 1 Kings 1 takes fifty-three verses to tell, and with no mention of Adonijah at all.; 'I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah' (1Kgs 1:35), spoken to Zadok, Nathan and Benaiah after David is summoned to answer for the oath.
'That night God appeared to Solomon and said, Ask, and I will give it to you!' (2Chr 1:7), and a second time after the temple was finished: 'the LORD appeared to him at night' (7:12).
'God's Tent of Meeting, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness' (2Chr 1:3) -- still standing at Gibeon in Solomon's day, generations after Exodus 40:18.

'Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people.' (2Chr 1:10), asked on the ground of what was given his father: 'You have shown much loving devotion to my father David, and You have made me king in his place' (1:8).
'And Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon because it was the location of God's Tent of Meeting' (2Chr 1:3), returning to Jerusalem at 1:13.
